rationale: The stock gapped down ~16% at the open and has since bounced from $50.17 to $55.00, placing price at 68% of today's range and above both VWAP ($54.35) and the 9-EMA ($54.37) — suggesting the initial selling has been partially absorbed. However, the last two 1-minute candles show a clear reversal from the session high ($57.25) with declining closes and increasing volume, indicating distribution near resistance. With ATR at ~$1.02 on 5-minute bars, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear: a long risks a retest of VWAP/low, while a short risks continuation of the gap-fill bounce toward $57.25+. The conflicting signals and high volatility environment (VIXY +2.60%) make this an unfavorable moment to commit capital.
